title: Dipsy Doodle / Doodle Bug / Love Bug

source.label: Williams Dipsy Doodle factory instruction cards

strategy.overview: Dipsy Doodle, Doodle Bug, and Love Bug begin with upper-playfield survival. Raise the center post through a side up-post lane, then use controlled micro-flips to hit targets 1 through 4 in order. Hit the center target to start the Doodler, then send the ball up top while avoiding switches that stop it.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Dipsy Doodle, Doodle Bug, or Love Bug, first raise the center post through a side up-post lane. Then hit targets 1, 2, 3, and 4 in order and shoot the center target to start the Doodler. Send the ball up top without touching a stop-Doodler rollover.
strategy.summary: Protection comes before the target sequence. Complete 1–4 to raise the Doodler value, start it at the center target, and keep the ball between the bumpers while it runs. Love Bug can raise the Doodler through more value steps than Dipsy Doodle.

quickInfo.name: Raise center post
quickInfo.summary: Use either side up-post lane before attempting the numbered targets.

quickInfo.name: Targets 1 through 4
quickInfo.summary: Hit them in order to raise the Doodler value; Love Bug supports additional tenfold advances.

quickInfo.name: Start Doodler
quickInfo.summary: Hit the center target after the numbered sequence is ready.

quickInfo.name: Stop Doodler
quickInfo.summary: Top horizontal slings, side up-post lanes, the outlane switch, or the end of the ball stop the running feature.

steps.text: Plunge for the top saucer, favoring an award that lights a bumper color or a useful 5,000 value.
Keep the ball up top until either side up-post lane raises the center post.
Settle the ball against the post and use small transfers to shoot targets 1, 2, 3, and 4 in order.
Hit the center target to start the Doodler, accepting that this lowers the center post.
Send the ball into the interior bumper area while avoiding the stop-Doodler rollovers for as long as possible.
Raise the post and complete targets 1–4 in order.
Start the Doodler at the center target.
Keep the ball alive in the bumper area without touching a stop switch.

machineSetup: Identify the copy and installed award card: Dipsy Doodle raises the Doodler from 10 to 100, while Love Bug adds higher value steps and may award an additional ball for the completed sequence.

Test the top saucer and award cycle, both up-post lanes, center post and down-post switches, targets 1–4 and sequence lamps, center start target, Doodler unit, bumper lights, right gate, and every stop switch.
